import contextlib, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, runpy, signal, sys, unittest
method = "test_artifact_valid_and_rejection_matrix"
out = {"schema": 1, "target": "local-artifact-predicate-v1", "methods": [method], "result": "failed", "tests": 0, "failures": 0, "errors": 1, "skipped": 0, "fixture_cleanup": "unknown"}
def timeout(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError()
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, timeout)
signal.alarm(10)
try:
    expected = {"docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/build.py": "e8e4e8b101de974ce1878162a9ebec8335ddd4b1f9a977b52c2682522d903b32", "docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/Tests/test_build.py": "bb4896223fe5f12caf0f91cac1016b17e51530e8247d7f4c28d8659787c8fa6c", "docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-build-contract.md": "ba550bc774ddc97ab43957f5f7c73b9d1c5a84f359b5ba0f4c77af9d5c47b470"}
    for path, digest in expected.items():
        if hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            raise ValueError()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        module = runpy.run_path("docs/planning/poc/client-framework/native-lab/Tests/test_build.py", run_name="artifact_predicate_target")
